title: Agents you can coach: how Asana builds human-agent teams with Claude
summary: Asana embeds AI agents as teammates in its Work Graph with roles, permissions, and shared memory. Agents retain learning across tasks and can be coached by designated team members; permanent behavior changes require admin approval, keeping operations transparent and accountable.

title: Build plugins for Claude
summary: Developers on paid plans can now publish plugins via a directory portal with auto-validation and safety scanning. Claude supports MCP 2.0 with interactive UI and enterprise-managed auth, plus plugin analytics for install metrics and search data across Claude and Claude Code.

title: How CodeRabbit, Power Digital, and ThoughtSpot scale with Snowflake and Vercel on Claude Marketplace
summary: Claude Marketplace lets companies redirect Anthropic commitments to partners like Snowflake and Vercel. Companies use this to run inference within governance boundaries and streamline cloud costs while partners benefit from faster customer acquisition and shorter sales cycles.

title: How to prepare for AI-driven code modernization projects
summary: A six-step framework for AI-powered code modernization prioritizes verification certificates and tiered review by risk over manual review alone. This approach accelerates production deployment for version updates, language rewrites, and architectural rebuilds.

title: Customize Claude Code with mods
summary: Claude Code now supports mods—small TypeScript functions that customize behavior, appearance, and features. They can run before, after, or instead of standard operations (redacting secrets, rewriting tool calls, managing permissions), stack from multiple authors, and can be restricted by admins via security defaults.

title: Giving companies more control over their AI agents, with NVIDIA
summary: Claude Managed Agents integrates with NVIDIA's Open Agent Safety Platform, holding credentials in a separate vault and enforcing policies outside the model. Mathematical proofs confirm access limits and audit trails track all agent actions, critical as agents gain broader access to proprietary systems and data.
